name: Vaporesso XROS 3 Pod Kit
description: The XROS 3 is the pod kit that converted pipe smokers to vaping — and occasionally back again. Compact enough for a waistcoat pocket, it produces a warm, restricted draw that approximates the feel of a pipe stem more closely than most vaping devices. The 1000mAh battery lasts a full day of moderate use. Available in Midnight Blue, Classic Black, and Brushed Gold.

name: Lost Mary BM600 Disposable — Tobacco Ice
description: A 600-puff disposable in the Tobacco Ice flavour — a lightly menthol-cooled tobacco base that reads as tobacco without the weight of an actual blend. For the traveller who wants something simpler than a kit for a day out. Compliant with UK TPD regulations. Single use; dispose of responsibly.

name: Dinner Lady Tobacco Crème E-Liquid 50ml
description: A 70/30 VG/PG shortfill e-liquid in a flavour profile designed specifically for pipe and cigar smokers transitioning to vaping — the Tobacco Crème leads with a smooth Virginia-style tobacco note and finishes with a light vanilla cream that would not be out of place in an aromatic blend. Nicotine-free as supplied; add a nicotine shot to achieve your preferred strength. 50ml in a 60ml bottle.

name: Vaporesso GTX ONE Starter Kit
description: A complete starter kit for the pipe smoker who wants to understand vaping properly before committing to a more advanced setup. Includes the GTX ONE device, two coil heads (0.6Ω for warmer vaping, 0.8Ω for a cooler, more restricted draw), a 2ml pod, and a USB-C cable. The variable wattage runs from 5 to 40W, which covers the full range of experience from barely-there vapour to a satisfying cloud.

name: Vaporesso GTX Coils 0.6Ω (5-pack)
description: Replacement 0.6Ω mesh coils for the Vaporesso GTX range. At this resistance, the coil runs warm and produces a vapour density that most pipe smokers find satisfying. Replace when vapour production drops noticeably or a burnt note enters the flavour — typically every one to two weeks with moderate use. Five coils per pack.
